ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Matias wrote 15 numbers on the wheel represented beside. Only one of them is visible, the 10 on top of the wheel. The sum of the numbers in any seven consecutive positions, such as the gray positions in the figure, does not vary. When seven numbers in consecutive positions are summed up, which of the following results is possible?

method.method_draft: Prove the entries are forced by the equal-sum condition. From the image, label the 15 circular positions in order around the wheel, with the top position equal to 10. From the text, every block of seven consecutive positions has the same sum. Compare two adjacent seven-position blocks: they share six positions, so subtracting their equal sums shows the number that leaves the block equals the new number that enters, i.e. each position equals the position 7 steps later. Since stepping by 7 around a 15-position wheel visits all positions because gcd(7,15)=1, every position must equal the top value 10. Therefore the constant seven-position sum is 7×10=70.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个圆形轮盘，外圈有15个位置，每个位置用小圆表示；顶部位置的小圆内可见数字10。图中还用灰色标出了若干个连续位置，表示题目所说的连续七个位置求和。推理：按顺时针把15个位置标为x_0,x_1,...,x_14，其中顶部可见位置为x_0=10。设任意连续七个位置的和都等于同一个常数S。比较相邻的两个七项和：S_i=x_i+x_{i+1}+...+x_{i+6}，S_{i+1}=x_{i+1}+x_{i+2}+...+x_{i+7}。因为它们相等，且中间六项相同，消去后得到x_i=x_{i+7}。这对所有i都成立。由于在15个位置上每次前进7步会遍历所有位置，因为gcd(7,15)=1，所以所有位置的数都相等。既然顶部位置是10，所有15个数都必须是10。因此任意七个连续位置的和为7×10=70。
